subject: Request: provider roster + dataflow evidence for procurement review
messages:
From: Daniel Liu <daniel.liu@healthbridge.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:14:28 -0700
Subject: Request: provider roster + dataflow evidence for procurement review

Vivek / Camila,

We're kicking off the procurement security review for Redwood as part of our platform onboarding. Procurement needs a concise inventory and evidence pack to complete the SIG/CAIQ pass:

- A CSV roster of all third-party providers (hosted services, analytics, monitoring, CDNs, infra, SaaS) used in production, with columns: provider name, service used, environment (prod/non-prod), data types processed, country of provider, contract date, and point of contact.
- A short mapping that indicates who owns the encryption keys / KMS (our side vs vendor) and whether customer data is encrypted at rest in the provider.
- Redacted copies of the contractual clauses that reference subprocessors and data transfer (we only need the pages that show the clause and effective date).
- Access to your SOC 2 report (or readiness attestation) and any applicable CAIQ/SIG answers if available.

Attached is our inventory template to make it easier to import: HealthBridge_Sig_Inventory_Template.csv (we prefer CSV). Would it be possible to have the initial export and evidence by EOD Aug 26? If not, let us know a realistic ETA.

Also can we schedule a quick 30-min call to walk through the roster and any ambiguities on Aug 24 or 25? Prefer afternoons PT.

Thank you,
Daniel Liu
Security & Compliance, HealthBridge Diagnostics
--
HealthBridge Diagnostics
D: +1 415 555 0198
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Liu <daniel.liu@healthbridge.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:05:12 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: provider roster + dataflow evidence for procurement review

Thanks Daniel — received and appreciate the template. We'll pull an export from our vendor inventory and produce a CSV matching your columns. High level:

- Deliverables we can provide by Aug 26: provider roster CSV, KMS ownership mapping (CSV), redacted contract clause snippets (PDF), and SOC 2 readiness statement.
- Things that take more time: full CAIQ completion (we typically provide a completed SIG/CAIQ on a slightly longer cadence) and signed attestations — these may need 1–2 additional business days or a formal request via our legal team.

Quick clarifying questions that will help scope:
1) Do you want production-only providers, or both prod and non-prod?
2) For KMS ownership, do you want a per-provider field (e.g., redwood-managed KMS / customer-managed / provider-managed)?
3) Are there any specific vendors you want prioritized (e.g., cloud infra, logging, analytics)?

We can do Aug 24 at 14:00 PT for a 30-min sync; I've tentatively proposed that on our side. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite.

Attaching an initial export snapshot (redwood_provider_roster_20260821.csv) — this is a raw extract and we will refine it to your requested columns.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 650 555 0123
From: Daniel Liu <daniel.liu@healthbridge.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: provider roster + dataflow evidence for procurement review

Vivek — thanks for the fast reply and for the export. A few clarifications from our procurement/security leads:

- Production-only is preferred for this pass. If there are edge services in non-prod that touch PHI, please flag them separately.
- Yes, please provide a per-provider KMS column with values (redwood-managed / customer-managed / provider-managed).
- Prioritize cloud infra (compute, storage), DB-as-a-service, logging/observability, and any ML model-hosting partners.
- For the contract clause snippets: redaction of commercial terms (pricing) is fine — we only need the clause language and signature/effective dates.

One more ask: can you include a short note about whether any subprocessors are based outside the US and whether transfers rely on standard contractual clauses or other mechanisms? That helps our legal team.

If Aug 26 is tight, EOD Aug 28 is acceptable. We'll take the call Aug 24 at 14:00 PT. Thanks — looking forward to the evidence pack.

Regards,
Daniel
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Liu <daniel.liu@healthbridge.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 16:02:05 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: provider roster + dataflow evidence for procurement review

Daniel — thanks, we have packaged the requested items and placed them in a secure shared folder. Summary below and a short checklist so you can validate quickly.

Shared items (drive link): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example-drive-link
Attached to this thread: redwood_provider_roster_20260821.csv; kms_ownership_map_20260821.csv; contract_clauses_redacted.pdf

Short summary:
- Provider roster: production-only export. Columns map to your template; flagged providers handling PHI in a separate column.
- KMS ownership: per-provider values (redwood-managed / provider-managed / customer-managed) and notes where we use cloud provider KMS for ephemeral keys.
- Contract snippets: redacted to remove pricing; clause language and executed dates are visible.
- Non-US subprocessors: listed in the roster with country column; transfers rely primarily on SCCs (Standard Contractual Clauses) with documented annexes where applicable.

Quick checklist for your team:
- [ ] Confirm roster column mapping matches import template
- [ ] Verify KMS ownership fields meet legal's needs
- [ ] Confirm redactions are sufficient for procurement review
- [ ] Request full CAIQ/SIG if you need a completed questionnaire (we can commit to delivering within 3 business days after this pack)

We will join the call on Aug 24, 14:00 PT (invite sent). If you'd like a named signer for the attestation PDF, let us know the required signer role (e.g., VP Legal or Head of Security) and we'll loop them in.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni

Redwood Inference
